directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay commenting on the saying "Help others, and you will be helped when you are in need " You can cite examples to illustrate your views. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
sample_essay:
"Help others, and you will be helped when you are in need." This age-old wisdom holds profound truth in our daily lives.

To begin with, helping others builds a strong social network. When we offer a helping hand to those around us, we create bonds of trust and friendship. For instance, if you help a classmate with their studies, they are more likely to support you in other aspects later. In addition, it promotes a positive cycle of kindness. Your act of kindness can inspire others to do the same. A simple act like donating clothes to the poor might encourage others in the community to follow suit, creating a more caring society. Furthermore, helping others can bring unexpected rewards. There was a man who helped an old woman cross the road. Years later, when he was in a financial crisis, the old woman's family offered him a job opportunity.

In conclusion, the saying "Help others, and you will be helped when you are in need" is not just a moral principle but also a practical guide for life. By helping others, we not only make the world a better place but also ensure that we will receive help when we need it most.
